translation_en:
Luo Xing, courtesy name Gongbei, was registered in a civilian household in Jianchuan Subprefecture, Heqing Prefecture, Yunnan, and was a native of Taihe County, Dali Prefecture. A subprefectural school student specializing in the Classic of Poetry, he ranked first among his siblings and was aged thirty-two, born on the second day of the sixth lunar month. His great-grandfather was Wubao; his grandfather, Gang; and his father, Wenji. His legal mother was née Shi, and his birth mother was née Cheng. His parents were deceased. His younger brothers were Mao, Di, and Guan. He married a woman née Zhao. He placed twenty-third in the Yunnan Provincial Examination and 186th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Zhen, courtesy name Yuanzhi, was registered in a military household of Yingchuan Guard, Henan. An Imperial University student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals, he ranked twelfth among his siblings and was aged thirty-five, born on the twenty-eighth day of the fifth lunar month. His great-grandfather Gui, grandfather Cong, and father Lan each held the title of honorary official (yiguan). His legal mother was née Zhang, and his birth mother was née Zheng. His parents were deceased. His elder brothers were Bing, granted the title of Secretary in the Ministry of Revenue; Deng, a government student granted the cap and girdle of official status; Huan; and Jing. He married a woman née Wang. He placed fifth in the Henan Provincial Examination and 285th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Boyuan, courtesy name Jingzhi, was registered in a civilian household in Cixi County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang. An attached student of the prefectural school specializing in the Classic of Poetry, he ranked third among his siblings and was aged thirty-one, born on the thirteenth day of the seventh lunar month. His great-grandfather was Ying; his grandfather, Leng; his father, Shilun; and his mother, née Chen. His parents were deceased. His elder brothers were Ru and Yong. He married a woman née Feng and subsequently a woman née Zhou. He placed twelfth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 200th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Shoutai, courtesy name Jiaofu, was registered in a civilian household in Macheng County, Huangzhou Prefecture, Huguang. An Imperial University student specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals, he ranked first among his siblings and was aged thirty-five, born on the twenty-second day of the sixth lunar month. His great-grandfather was Yan; his grandfather, Tianmin, a Professor in a princely establishment; his father, Lan, a District Magistrate; and his mother, née Zou. His parents were deceased. His elder brother was Shoufu, an Imperial University student; his younger brothers were Shouyi, Shouyou, Commander of the Embroidered-uniform Guard, and Shougui. He married a woman née Wang. He placed first in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 225th in the Metropolitan Examination.

宋存德〔貫南京錦衣衛軍籍，蘇州府吳縣人，國子生，治易經，字惟一，行四，年三十三，正月十一日生〕。曾祖賢，祖應翔，父溥〔通判〕，母楊氏。永感下。兄存祀、存禮、存仁。娶何氏，繼娶衣氏、朱氏。應天府鄉試第九十五名，會試第二百二十名。

趙舉廉〔貫河南歸德府睢州睢陽衛軍籍，州學附學生，治書經，字汝介，行二，年二十四，五月二十六日生〕。曾祖國卿〔壽官〕，祖名儒〔典膳〕，父誥〔知縣〕，母翟氏。重慶下。兄舉孝；弟舉賢、舉良。娶傅氏。河南鄉試第十三名，會試第三百五十九名。
translation_en:
Liu Yangchong, courtesy name Yidao, was registered in a military household in Fuzhou, Chongqing Prefecture, Sichuan. A student of the department school specializing in the Book of Changes, he ranked seventeenth among his brothers and male cousins and was twenty-nine years old, born on the nineteenth day of the seventh month. His great-grandfather was Zhimao, posthumously appointed Supervising Secretary in the Office of Scrutiny for Revenue; his grandfather was Chai, Surveillance Vice Commissioner; and his father was Chengwu, Subprefect. His legal mother was née Huang and his birth mother née Zhang. His father was deceased and his mother living. His elder brothers were Yangcheng, Yanghe, Yanggao, and Yangyi; his younger brothers were Yangqian, Yangzhong, Yangcheng [the name occurs again in the transcription; ?], Yangduan, Yangfu, and Yangjie. He married a woman née Wang and subsequently another woman née Wang. He placed second in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 281st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Song Cunde, courtesy name Weiyi, was registered in a military household of the Nanjing Embroidered-Uniform Guard and was a native of Wu County, Suzhou Prefecture. A student of the Imperial University specializing in the Book of Changes, he ranked fourth among his brothers and male cousins and was thirty-three years old, born on the eleventh day of the first month. His great-grandfather was Xian, his grandfather Yingxiang, and his father Pu, Subprefect; his mother was née Yang. Both parents were deceased. His elder brothers were Cunsi, Cunli, and Cunren. He married a woman née He and subsequently women née Yi and née Zhu. He placed ninety-fifth in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 220th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zheng Rui, courtesy name Xunqing, was registered in a civilian household in Jing County, Ningguo Prefecture, Zhili. An additional student of the county school specializing in the Book of Documents, he ranked third among his brothers and male cousins and was thirty years old, born on the fifth day of the eleventh month. His great-grandfather was Yude, his grandfather Chang, and his father Jue, granted the title of Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; his mother was née Wang. His father was deceased and his mother living. His elder brothers were Qin, Supervising Secretary in the Office of Scrutiny for Revenue, and Ming; his younger brothers were Kuang, Kai, Yue, and Mo. He married a woman née Hu and subsequently a woman née Wang. He placed sixty-sixth in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and forty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhao Julian, courtesy name Rujie, was registered in a military household of Suiyang Guard in Suizhou, Guide Prefecture, Henan. An attached student of the department school specializing in the Book of Documents, he ranked second among his brothers and male cousins and was twenty-four years old, born on the twenty-sixth day of the fifth month. His great-grandfather was Guoqing, an honorary official for longevity; his grandfather was Mingru, Steward of Provisions; and his father was Gao, District Magistrate. His mother was née Zhai. Both parents and at least one grandparent were living. His elder brother was Juxiao, and his younger brothers were Juxian and Juliang. He married a woman née Fu. He placed thirteenth in the Henan Provincial Examination and 359th in the Metropolitan Examination.

趙燿〔貫山東萊州府掖縣軍籍，縣學生，治詩經，字文明，行一，年三十三，二月二十九日生〕。曾祖秀，祖惠〔義官〕，父孟〔王府教授〕，前母張氏，母孫氏。具慶下，弟宦〔監察御史〕、燦，娶馬氏。山東鄉試第二十五名，會試第一百二十一名。

馮時可〔貫應天府軍籍，松江府華亭縣人，國子生，治詩經，字敏卿，行八，年二十三，九月二十九日生〕。曾祖海，祖逵〔贈南京監察御史〕，父恩〔大理寺寺丞，進階朝列大夫〕，嫡母金氏〔封孺人〕，生母馬氏。嚴侍下，兄行可〔貢士〕、達可、學可、再可、輔可、繼可〔俱監生〕、敷可、衍可，弟際可〔監生〕，娶徐氏。應天府鄉試第三十名，會試第五十八名。

姚學閔〔貫湖廣常德府武陵縣民籍，縣學附學生，治春秋，字汝孝，行四，年二十七，三月二十九日生〕。曾祖正聰，祖應春，父世方，前母聶氏，母曾氏。具慶下，兄學孔、學曾、學顏，弟學牛、學張、學冉、學端、學周、學程，娶白氏。湖廣鄉試第六十六名，會試第一百四十名。

黃道年〔貫直隸廬州府合肥縣軍籍，國子生，治書經，字延卿，行一，年二十七，三月十九日生〕。曾祖賓，祖紀，父意〔省祭官〕，母敖氏。具慶下，弟道月、道日、道時、道星，娶李氏。應天府鄉試第九十名，會試第二百五十八名。
translation_en:
Zhao Yao, registered in a military household in Ye County, Laizhou Prefecture, Shandong, was a county school student specializing in the Book of Odes. His courtesy name was Wenming, and he ranked first among his brothers. He was thirty-three, born on the twenty-ninth day of the second month. His great-grandfather was Xiu; his grandfather was Hui, an honorary official for righteousness; and his father was Meng, a Professor in a princely establishment. His father's former wife was née Zhang, and his mother was née Sun. Both parents were living. His younger brothers were Huan, an Investigating Censor, and Can. He married a woman née Ma. He placed twenty-fifth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 121st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Feng Shike was registered in a military household in Yingtian Prefecture and was a native of Huating County, Songjiang Prefecture. He was an Imperial University student specializing in the Book of Odes. His courtesy name was Minqing, and he ranked eighth among his brothers. He was twenty-three, born on the twenty-ninth day of the ninth month. His great-grandfather was Hai; his grandfather was Kui, posthumously appointed Investigating Censor at Nanjing; and his father was En, Assistant Minister of the Court of Judicial Review, advanced to the prestige rank of chaolie dafu. His legal mother was née Jin, granted the title Lady (ruren), and his birth mother was née Ma. His father alone was living. His elder brothers were Xingke, a tribute scholar; Dake, Xueke, Zaike, Fuke, and Jike, all Imperial University students; Fuke (敷可); and Yanke. His younger brother was Jike (際可), an Imperial University student. He married a woman née Xu. He placed thirtieth in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and fifty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yao Xuemin, registered in a civilian household in Wuling County, Changde Prefecture, Huguang, was an attached student of the county school specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals. His courtesy name was Ruxiao, and he ranked fourth among his brothers. He was twenty-seven, born on the twenty-ninth day of the third month. His great-grandfather was Zhengcong; his grandfather was Yingchun; and his father was Shifang. His father's former wife was née Nie, and his mother was née Zeng. Both parents were living. His elder brothers were Xuekong, Xuezeng, and Xueyan; his younger brothers were Xueniu, Xuezhang, Xueran, Xueduan, Xuezhou, and Xuecheng. He married a woman née Bai. He placed sixty-sixth in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 140th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Huang Daonian, registered in a military household in Hefei County, Luzhou Prefecture, in the directly administered metropolitan region, was an Imperial University student specializing in the Book of Documents. His courtesy name was Yanqing, and he ranked first among his brothers. He was twenty-seven, born on the nineteenth day of the third month. His great-grandfather was Bin; his grandfather was Ji; and his father was Yi, a sacrificial official (shengji guan). His mother was née Ao. Both parents were living. His younger brothers were Daoyue, Daori, Daoshi, and Daoxing. He married a woman née Li. He placed ninetieth in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 258th in the Metropolitan Examination.

曹司勳〔貫直隸常州府宜興縣民籍，縣學附學生，治禮記，字應麒，行二，年二十三，六月十九日生〕。曾祖詔〔贈布政司左布政使〕，祖珮〔贈布政司左布政使〕，父三暘〔都察院右副都御史〕，嫡母呂氏〔封恭人〕，生母尹氏。具慶下。兄司宰〔監生〕，弟司直、司綸、司農、司教、司敕。娶史氏。應天府鄉試第十五名，會試第三百十五名。

齊一經〔貫山東萊州府平度州濰縣民籍，縣學增廣生，治詩經，字訓汝，行一，年三十三，四月初七日生〕。曾祖翱，祖英，父聞樂，母劉氏，繼母信氏。慈侍下。弟一夔、一中。娶管氏。山東鄉試第四十八名，會試第二百七十四名。

王祖嫡〔貫河南信陽衛官籍，山東德州人，國子生，治易經，字胤昌，行一，年四十，五月十八日生〕。曾祖端〔指揮僉事〕，祖瑀〔指揮僉事〕，父詔〔指揮僉事〕，母袁氏〔封恭人〕。慈侍下。弟祖賚。娶孟氏，繼娶高氏。河南鄉試第十一名，會試第八十七名。

張綸〔貫直隸保定府清苑縣民籍，國子生，治詩經，字子合，行三，年三十九，六月初六日生〕。曾祖進，祖智，父翱，前母楊氏，母趙氏，繼母冉氏、霍氏。慈侍下。兄經、緯，弟績、綬。娶王氏。順天府鄉試第一百二十一名，會試第三百五十四名。
translation_en:
Cao Sixun, courtesy name Yingqi, was registered in a civilian household in Yixing County, Changzhou Prefecture, in the directly administered metropolitan region; he was an attached student of the county school and specialized in the Book of Rites. Second in birth order, he was twenty-three years old and was born on the nineteenth day of the sixth month. His great-grandfather Zhao and grandfather Pei were both posthumously granted the title of Left Provincial Administration Commissioner; his father Sanyang was Right Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Censorate. His legal mother, née Lü, held the title Lady of Respect; his birth mother was née Yin. Both parents were living. His elder brother Sizai was an Imperial University student; his younger brothers were Sizhi, Silun, Sinong, Sijiao, and Sichi. His wife was née Shi. He placed fifteenth in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 315th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Qi Yijing, courtesy name Xunru, was registered in a civilian household in Wei County, Pingdu Subprefecture, Laizhou Prefecture, Shandong; he was an additional student of the county school and specialized in the Book of Odes. First in birth order, he was thirty-three years old and was born on the seventh day of the fourth month. His great-grandfather was Ao, his grandfather Ying, and his father Wenle; his mother was née Liu and his stepmother née Xin. His father was deceased and his mother living. His younger brothers were Yikui and Yizhong. His wife was née Guan. He placed forty-eighth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 274th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Zudi, courtesy name Yinchang, was registered in an officer household of Xinyang Guard, Henan, and was a native of Dezhou, Shandong; he was an Imperial University student and specialized in the Book of Changes. First in birth order, he was forty years old and was born on the eighteenth day of the fifth month. His great-grandfather Duan, grandfather Yu, and father Zhao each held the office of Assistant Commander. His mother, née Yuan, held the title Lady of Respect. His father was deceased and his mother living. His younger brother was Zulai. His wife was née Meng; he subsequently married a woman née Gao. He placed eleventh in the Henan Provincial Examination and eighty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Lun, courtesy name Zihe, was registered in a civilian household in Qingyuan County, Baoding Prefecture, in the directly administered metropolitan region; he was an Imperial University student and specialized in the Book of Odes. Third in birth order, he was thirty-nine years old and was born on the sixth day of the sixth month. His great-grandfather was Jin, his grandfather Zhi, and his father Ao; his father's former wife was née Yang, his mother née Zhao, and his stepmothers née Ran and née Huo. His father was deceased and his mother living. His elder brothers were Jing and Wei; his younger brothers were Ji and Shou. His wife was née Wang. He placed 121st in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 354th in the Metropolitan Examination.

title: 隆慶五年進士登科錄
text:
宋儒〔貫貴州都勻府麻合州官籍直隸定州人國子生治詩經字醇夫行一年三十五四月二十七日生〕

江沛然〔貫湖廣武昌府江夏縣民籍，黃州府黃岡縣人，國子生，治詩經，字應吾，行二，年三十五，十二月初五日生〕。曾祖勝先，祖友仁，父濟，母陶氏，繼母李氏。嚴侍下，兄自然、浩然，娶張氏。湖廣鄉試第二十二名，會試第三十六名。
translation_en:
Song Ru, registered in an official household in Mahe Subprefecture [?], Duyun Prefecture, Guizhou, was originally from Dingzhou, directly administered by the capital. A student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Poetry, he had the courtesy name Chunfu and ranked first among his brothers; he was thirty-five, born on the twenty-seventh day of the fourth lunar month. His great-grandfather Yue, grandfather Ding, and father Zhu each served as subprefectural vice magistrate; his mother was née Xiao. Both parents were living. His younger brothers were Qian, Bo, Cun, Xiu, Xie, and Yi, and his wife was née Jin. He placed twenty-second in the Guizhou Provincial Examination and 252nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Sike, registered in a military household in Ziyang County, Hanzhong Prefecture, Shaanxi, was originally from Jingyang County, Xi’an Prefecture. A student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Poetry, he had the courtesy name Xizhe and ranked third among his brothers; he was twenty-seven, born on the twenty-third day of the eighth lunar month. His great-grandfather was Tong; his grandfather Chong was posthumously granted the title of Guard Registrar; his father Teng was a county assistant magistrate. His mother was née Zheng, and his stepmother was née Xu. Both parents were living. His elder brothers were Siwei and Sida, and his younger brothers were Siduan, Sizhen, and Siyu; his wife was née Kong. He placed twenty-seventh in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 269th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Shen Sike was registered in a civilian household in Weichuan County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan. A county government school student specializing in the Classic of Changes, he had the courtesy name Dengfu and ranked first among his brothers; he was thirty-four, born on the twenty-third day of the first lunar month. His great-grandfather was Xi, his grandfather Er, his father Shan, and his mother née Qin. Both parents were deceased. His first wife was née Bai, and his subsequent wife was née Ning. He placed fifty-second in the Henan Provincial Examination and 369th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Jiang Peiran, registered in a civilian household in Jiangxia County, Wuchang Prefecture, Huguang, was originally from Huanggang County, Huangzhou Prefecture. A student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Classic of Poetry, he had the courtesy name Yingwu and ranked second among his brothers; he was thirty-five, born on the fifth day of the twelfth lunar month. His great-grandfather was Shengxian, his grandfather Youren, and his father Ji; his mother was née Tao, and his stepmother was née Li. His father was living and his mother deceased. His elder brothers were Ziran and Haoran, and his wife was née Zhang. He placed twenty-second in the Huguang Provincial Examination and thirty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Zhang Yikun 張一鯤, courtesy name Boda, was registered in a civilian household in Dingyuan County, Hezhou, Chongqing Prefecture, Sichuan. A county school student specializing in the Book of Changes, he was second in birth order, aged thirty-nine, and born on the sixteenth day of the eleventh lunar month. His great-grandfather was Taichu, an eighth-rank prestige official; his grandfather was Shoufu; and his father was Yin. His mother was née Wu, and his stepmother was née Wang. Both parents were deceased. His elder brother, Yi'e, was an eighth-rank prestige official, and his younger brother, Yihe, was an annual tribute student. His wife was née Xi. He placed eleventh in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 275th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Meng Qiu 孟秋, courtesy name Zicheng, was registered in a civilian household in Chiping County, Dongchang Prefecture, Shandong. A student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Book of Documents, he was second in birth order, aged forty-seven, and born on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month. His great-grandfather was Kuan; his grandfather was Tong; and his father was Feng, a sacrificial official (shengjiguan). His legal mother was née Man, and his birth mother was née Song. Both parents were deceased. His elder brother was Chun, and his wife was née Jiang. He placed eightieth in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 231st in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xiao Chongye 蕭崇業, courtesy name Yunxiu, was registered in a military banner household of Lin'an Guard, Yunnan, and was a native of Shangyuan County, Yingtian Prefecture. A Lin'an prefectural school student specializing in the Book of Odes, he was first in birth order, aged thirty-four, and born on the thirtieth day of the third lunar month. His great-grandfather was Rong; his grandfather was Wendi; and his father was Zhigao, an honorary official for longevity. His father's former wife was née Qu, and his mother was née Rong. His father was deceased, and his mother was living. His younger brothers were Chongli and Chonggong, and his wife was née Hu. He placed second in the Yunnan Provincial Examination and 106th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhan Quanjue 詹全覺, courtesy name Kexian, was registered in a military household in Duchang County, Nankang Prefecture, Jiangxi. An additional student of the county school specializing in the Book of Rites, he was second in birth order, aged twenty-six, and born on the eighteenth day of the fourth lunar month. His great-grandfather was Chi; his grandfather was Yue; and his father was Tianyu. His mother was née Shen, and his stepmothers were née Wang and née Xie. Both parents were living. His elder brother was Quanjian, his younger brother was Quanguan, and his wife was née Yang. He placed fifty-fifth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and thirty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

translation_en:
Jiang Qifang 姜竒方, courtesy name Mengying, was registered in a civilian household in Jianli County, Jingzhou Prefecture, Huguang. A student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Book of Changes, he ranked first among his brothers and was thirty-six years old, born on the sixth day of the second lunar month. His great-grandfather was Sheng, his grandfather Chongyao, and his father Yuncheng; his mother was née Kuang. His mother alone was still living. His younger brothers were Yanfang, Shufang, Defang, and Kuifang, and his wife was née Xu. He placed seventy-third in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 182nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Hao Kongzhao 郝孔昭, courtesy name Qiqian, was registered in a civilian household in Lai'an County, Chuzhou, in the directly administered metropolitan region. A student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Book of Odes, he ranked first among his brothers and was twenty-nine years old, born on the thirteenth day of the eleventh lunar month. His great-grandfather was Xuan, his grandfather Xi, and his father Zhu; his mother was née Zhang. Both parents were still living. His elder brothers were Shiqi, an Assistant Instructor, and Shiyan, a District Magistrate. His wife was née Zhang, and his subsequent wife was née Lu. He placed twenty-sixth in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 373rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tu Jie 涂杰, courtesy name Rugao, was registered in a military household in Xinjian County, Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi, and was a native of Nanchang County. A prefectural school student specializing in the Book of Changes, he ranked third among his brothers and was twenty-five years old, born on the seventeenth day of the tenth lunar month. His great-grandfather was Gui, his grandfather Luan, and his father Qian; his mother was née Chen. His mother alone was still living. His elder brother was Ben, and his wife was née Liu. He placed ninth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 207th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Huiqian 吳撝謙, courtesy name R uze [Ruze], was registered in a civilian household in Linchuan County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Jiangxi. An additional student of the county school specializing in the Book of Changes, he ranked eighth among his brothers and was thirty-one years old, born on the nineteenth day of the tenth lunar month. His great-grandfather was Fu, who held an honorary official title for longevity; his grandfather was Run, and his father Tingxiang; his mother was née Zhong. His parents and at least one grandparent were still living. His younger brothers were Keqian, Huaiqian, Yiqian, Yangqian, Wenqian, Shouqian, and Junqian, and his wife was née Zhang. He placed thirty-sixth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 213th in the Metropolitan Examination.

余良楨〔貫江西南昌府奉新縣，軍籍，國子生，治書經，字士翼，行三，年四十五，三月二十一日生〕。曾祖嗣文，祖孔榮〔贈順天府經歷〕，父茂〔通判〕，母魏氏〔封孺人〕。慈侍下，兄良能〔序班〕，弟良士、良樞〔同科進士〕、良登，娶張氏。江西鄉試第七十七名，會試第三十四名。

苗煥〔貫山西澤州，民籍，國子生，治詩經，字爾章，行一，年二十八，六月十三日生〕。曾祖銑，祖時雍〔縣丞〕，父杰，母李氏，繼母李氏。嚴侍下，娶司氏。山西鄉試第二十二名，會試第六十八名。

趙善政〔貫直隸寧國府涇縣，民籍，國子生，治詩經，字以德，行一，年二十八，二月二十七日生〕。曾祖僖，祖鈿，父瑨〔訓導〕，母左氏。重慶下，弟善慶、善敬、善為、善元，娶左氏。應天府鄉試第七十五名，會試第八十八名。

安九域〔貫河南開封府鈞州，民籍，國子生，治書經，字于統，行四，年三十三，閏七月初八日生〕。曾祖永遠〔知縣〕，祖觀，父大法，母王氏。慈侍下，兄九棘、九居、九族、九峯、九仞、九齡、九臯、九賦、九一，弟九川，娶李氏。河南鄉試第二十一名，會試第三百八名。
translation_en:
Yu Liangzhen, registered in Fengxin County, Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi, belonged to a military household and was a student of the Directorate of Education. He specialized in the Book of Documents; his courtesy name was Shiyi, and he ranked third among his brothers. He was forty-five years old, born on the twenty-first day of the third lunar month. His great-grandfather was Siwen; his grandfather, Kongrong, was posthumously appointed Registrar of Shuntian Prefecture; his father, Mao, was an Assistant Prefect; and his mother, née Wei, was granted the title Lady (ruren). His mother alone was still living. His elder brother was Liangneng, an Usher; his younger brothers were Liangshi, Liangshu (a metropolitan graduate in the same examination cohort), and Liangdeng. He married a woman née Zhang. He placed seventy-seventh in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and thirty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Miao Huan, registered in Zezhou, Shanxi, belonged to a civilian household and was a student of the Directorate of Education. He specialized in the Book of Odes; his courtesy name was Erzhang, and he ranked first among his brothers. He was twenty-eight years old, born on the thirteenth day of the sixth lunar month. His great-grandfather was Xian; his grandfather, Shiyong, was a County Vice Magistrate; his father was Jie; his mother was née Li, and his stepmother was also née Li. His father alone was still living. He married a woman née Si. He placed twenty-second in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and sixty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhao Shanzheng, registered in Jing County, Ningguo Prefecture, Zhili, belonged to a civilian household and was a student of the Directorate of Education. He specialized in the Book of Odes; his courtesy name was Yide, and he ranked first among his brothers. He was twenty-eight years old, born on the twenty-seventh day of the second lunar month. His great-grandfather was Xi; his grandfather was Dian; his father, Jin, was an Assistant Instructor; and his mother was née Zuo. His parents and at least one grandparent were still living. His younger brothers were Shanqing, Shanjing, Shanwei, and Shanyuan. He married a woman née Zuo. He placed seventy-fifth in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and eighty-eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

An Jiuyu, registered in Junzhou, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan, belonged to a civilian household and was a student of the Directorate of Education. He specialized in the Book of Documents; his courtesy name was Yutong, and he ranked fourth among his brothers. He was thirty-three years old, born on the eighth day of the intercalary seventh lunar month. His great-grandfather, Yongyuan, was a County Magistrate; his grandfather was Guan; his father was Dafa; and his mother was née Wang. His mother alone was still living. His elder brothers were Jiuji, Jiuju, Jiuzu, Jiufeng, Jiuren, Jiuling, Jiugao, Jiufu, and Jiuyi; his younger brother was Jiuchuan. He married a woman née Li. He placed twenty-first in the Henan Provincial Examination and three hundred eighth in the Metropolitan Examination.

江和〔貫江西南昌府進賢縣，民籍，縣學附學生，治書經，字民貴，行五，年三十，十二月十二日生〕。曾祖正洪，祖朝興，父汲，前母楊氏，母侯氏。具慶下，弟穆，娶龔氏。江西鄉試第三十二名，會試第七十二名。

劉希孟〔貫山東青州府安丘縣，軍籍，縣學增廣生，治書經，字醇甫，行七，年三十三，九月初四日生〕。曾祖約，祖普〔壽官〕，父魁〔縣主簿〕，前母馮氏，母董氏。慈侍下，兄希龍〔按察司副使〕、希尹〔教諭〕、希禹、希周、希曾，弟希程，娶李氏，繼娶王氏。山東鄉試第四名，會試第二百七十六名。

王胤祥〔貫直隸撫寧衛，軍籍，直隸丹徒縣人，撫寧縣學生，治易經，字邦瑞，行一，年三十三，十二月二十五日生〕。曾祖喜，祖璘，父枕，前母祁氏，母單氏。具慶下，弟胤祜，娶傅氏。順天府鄉試第一百三十四名，會試第一百七十二名。

段補〔貫陝西臨洮府蘭州，軍籍，山西陽曲縣人，國子生，治易經，字希仲，行一，年四十二，九月初八日生〕。曾祖曠，祖增〔贈奉政大夫、南京兵部郎中〕，父續〔按察司副使，加從三品俸〕，前母陳氏〔贈宜人〕、陳氏，母劉氏〔封宜人〕。慈侍下，弟表、裳、袍，娶陳氏，繼娶李氏。陝西鄉試第五十四名，會試第三百二十九名。
translation_en:
Jiang He, registered in Jinxian County, Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi, belonged to a civilian household and was a supplementary student at the county school. He specialized in the Book of Documents. His courtesy name was Mingui; he ranked fifth among his brothers and was thirty years old, born on the twelfth day of the twelfth month. His great-grandfather was Zhenghong, his grandfather Chaoxing, and his father Ji. His father's former wife was Lady Yang, and his mother was Lady Hou. Both parents were living. His younger brother was Mu, and he married Lady Gong. He placed thirty-second in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and seventy-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Ximeng, registered in Anqiu County, Qingzhou Prefecture, Shandong, belonged to a military household and was an additional student at the county school. He specialized in the Book of Documents. His courtesy name was Chunfu; he ranked seventh among his brothers and was thirty-three years old, born on the fourth day of the ninth month. His great-grandfather was Yue; his grandfather Pu held an honorary official title for longevity; and his father Kui was a county Registrar. His father's former wife was Lady Feng, and his mother was Lady Dong. His father was deceased, and his mother was living. His elder brothers were Xilong, a Surveillance Vice Commissioner; Xiyin, a county-school Instructor; Xiyu; Xizhou; and Xizeng. His younger brother was Xicheng. He married Lady Li and subsequently Lady Wang. He placed fourth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 276th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Yinxiang was registered in a military household of Funing Guard in the directly administered region and was a native of Dantu County in the directly administered region. He was a student at the Funing County school and specialized in the Book of Changes. His courtesy name was Bangrui; he ranked first among his brothers and was thirty-three years old, born on the twenty-fifth day of the twelfth month. His great-grandfather was Xi, his grandfather Lin, and his father Zhen. His father's former wife was Lady Qi, and his mother was Lady Shan. Both parents were living. His younger brother was Yinhu, and he married Lady Fu. He placed 134th in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 172nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Duan Bu was registered in a military household in Lanzhou, Lintao Prefecture, Shaanxi, and was a native of Yangqu County, Shanxi. He was a student of the Imperial University and specialized in the Book of Changes. His courtesy name was Xizhong; he ranked first among his brothers and was forty-two years old, born on the eighth day of the ninth month. His great-grandfather was Kuang. His grandfather Zeng was posthumously granted the titles of Grand Master for Governance and Director in the Nanjing Ministry of War. His father Xu was a Surveillance Vice Commissioner whose salary had been raised to that of the lower third rank. His father's former wives were Lady Chen, posthumously granted the title Lady of Suitability, and another Lady Chen; his mother was Lady Liu, granted the title Lady of Suitability. His father was deceased, and his mother was living. His younger brothers were Biao, Chang, and Pao. He married Lady Chen and subsequently Lady Li. He placed fifty-fourth in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 329th in the Metropolitan Examination.

王象乾〔貫山東濟南府新城縣匠籍，縣學增廣生，治詩經，字子廓，行一，年二十六，正月十四日生〕。曾祖麟〔王府教授，贈戶部主事〕，祖重光〔布政司左參議，贈太僕寺少卿〕，父之垣〔大理寺少卿〕，母于氏〔贈恭人〕，繼母路氏〔封孺人〕。重慶下，弟象坤〔禮部主事〕、象蒙〔貢士〕、象泰、象震、象賁、象晉、象艮、象節、象萃、象恒、象頤。娶張氏，繼娶毛氏。山東鄉試第二名，會試第一百七十名。

王湘〔貫四川叙州府富順縣竈籍，縣學附學生，治易經，字原楚，行二，年二十四，三月十三日生〕。曾祖集，祖輔，父三至，母彭氏，繼母杜氏。具慶下，兄沔、清，弟湛、澤、滿、瀛、洛、濬。娶汪氏。四川鄉試第五十三名，會試第二百七十七名。

丁應詔〔貫浙江湖州府長興縣民籍，縣學生，治書經，字國賓，行一，年三十二，五月十一日生〕。曾祖瓚〔壽官〕，祖曜〔典膳〕，父良卿〔布政司正理問〕，母蔣氏，繼母吳氏。具慶下，弟敬業、敬止〔監生〕、敬承、敬謹、敬所、應昌、應感、應嗣、應隆。娶李氏。浙江鄉試第三十七名，會試第一百九名。

王汝濂〔貫山西大同府懷仁縣官籍，國子生，治易經，字道源，行三，年三十八，三月二十一日生〕。曾祖智〔百戶〕，祖瑛〔百戶〕，父繼〔義官〕，母夏氏。慈侍下，兄汝湘、汝洛、崇瀾，弟濬、汝汲、汝淓、汝浹、崇凍、汝蒞。娶梁氏。山西鄉試第四十三名，會試第二百三十三名。
translation_en:
Wang Xiangqian 王象乾 was registered in an artisan household in Xincheng County, Ji’nan Prefecture, Shandong. An added student of the county school, he specialized in the Book of Odes. His courtesy name was Zikuo; he ranked first in his family and was twenty-six, born on the fourteenth day of the first lunar month. His great-grandfather Lin was a Professor in a princely establishment, posthumously appointed Secretary in the Ministry of Revenue; his grandfather Chongguang was Left Assistant Administration Commissioner, posthumously appointed Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud; and his father Zhiyuan was Vice Minister of the Court of Judicial Review. His mother, née Yu, was posthumously granted the title Lady of Respect (gongren), and his stepmother, née Lu, was granted the title Lady of Service (ruren). He had living parents and grandparents. His younger brothers were Xiangkun, Secretary in the Ministry of Rites; Xiangmeng, a tribute scholar (gongshi); Xiangtai; Xiangzhen; Xiangben; Xiangjin; Xianggen; Xiangjie; Xiangcui; Xiangheng; and Xiangyi. He married a woman née Zhang and subsequently a woman née Mao. He placed second in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 170th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Xiang 王湘 was registered in a salt-producing household in Fushun County, Xuzhou Prefecture, Sichuan. An attached student of the county school, he specialized in the Book of Changes. His courtesy name was Yuanchu; he ranked second in his family and was twenty-four, born on the thirteenth day of the third lunar month. His great-grandfather was Ji, his grandfather Fu, and his father Sanzhi; his mother was née Peng and his stepmother née Du. Both parents were living. His elder brothers were Mian and Qing, and his younger brothers were Zhan, Ze, Man, Ying, Luo, and Jun. He married a woman née Wang 汪. He placed fifty-third in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and 277th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ding Yingzhao 丁應詔 was registered in a civilian household in Changxing County, Huzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang. A student of the county school, he specialized in the Book of Documents. His courtesy name was Guobin; he ranked first in his family and was thirty-two, born on the eleventh day of the fifth lunar month. His great-grandfather Zan held an honorary office for longevity; his grandfather Yao was a Steward of a princely establishment; and his father Liangqing was Chief Judicial Officer in a Provincial Administration Commission. His mother was née Jiang and his stepmother née Wu. Both parents were living. His younger brothers were Jingye; Jingzhi, a National University student; Jingcheng; Jingjin; Jingsuo; Yingchang; Yinggan; Yingsi; and Yinglong. He married a woman née Li. He placed thirty-seventh in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 109th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wang Rulian 王汝濂 was registered in an official household in Huairen County, Datong Prefecture, Shanxi. A National University student, he specialized in the Book of Changes. His courtesy name was Daoyuan; he ranked third in his family and was thirty-eight, born on the twenty-first day of the third lunar month. His great-grandfather Zhi and grandfather Ying were each a Battalion Commander; his father Ji held an honorary office for public benefaction, and his mother was née Xia. His mother was living and his father deceased. His elder brothers were Ruxiang, Ruluo, and Chonglan, and his younger brothers were Jun, Ruji, Rufang, Rujia, Chongdong, and Ruli. He married a woman née Liang. He placed forty-third in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and 233rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
張宏綱〔貫福建永寧衛官籍，泉州府晉江縣人，國子生，治易經，字師正，行二，年三十二，十月十八日生〕。曾祖壽〔指揮同知〕，祖杲，父文俊，母劉氏。具慶下，兄宏謨〔指揮同知〕、宏紀、堅壁〔百戶〕、堅國，弟宏策、宏業、宏烈，娶王氏。福建鄉試第七十七名，會試第三十七名。

徐一櫃〔貫浙江衢州府西安縣民籍，府學增廣生，治禮記，字汝材，行七十九，年二十七，十月二十五日生〕。曾祖珍，祖雄甫，父湘，母葉氏。重慶下，兄一杰〔貢士〕，弟一璨，娶鄭氏。浙江鄉試第九十名，會試第三十三名。

徐學禮〔貫留守中衛官籍，直隸靈璧縣人，國子生，治禮記，字子立，行二，年三十一，四月初十日生〕。曾祖瓚〔指揮使，封昭勇將軍〕，祖行〔指揮使，封昭勇將軍〕，父繼勳〔指揮使，封昭勇將軍〕，母袁氏〔封淑人〕。具慶下，兄學詩〔大理寺右寺正〕，娶申氏，繼娶申氏。順天府鄉試第四十七名，會試第一百三十五名。

鄺彭齡〔貫廣東廣州府南海縣民籍，縣學附學生，治易經，字幼玄，行一，年三十六，十月十六日生〕。曾祖璧，祖瀾，父夢肖〔冠帶生員〕，母潘氏，繼母吳氏。嚴侍下，弟聃齡，娶高氏。廣東鄉試第二名，會試第二百九十六名。
translation_en:
Zhang Honggang, registered in an official household of Yongning Guard, Fujian, was a native of Jinjiang County, Quanzhou Prefecture, and a student of the Directorate of Education. He specialized in the Book of Changes; his courtesy name was Shizheng. Second in family order, he was aged thirty-two and was born on the eighteenth day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather Shou was a Guard Vice Commander; his grandfather was Gao, his father Wenjun, and his mother Lady Liu. Both parents were living. His elder brothers were Hongmo, a Guard Vice Commander; Hongji; Jianbi, a Company Commander; and Jianguo. His younger brothers were Hongce, Hongye, and Honglie. He married Lady Wang. He ranked seventy-seventh in the Fujian Provincial Examination and thirty-seventh in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Yigui, registered in a civilian household of Xi’an County, Quzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang, was an added-quota student of the prefectural school. He specialized in the Book of Rites; his courtesy name was Rucai. Seventy-ninth in family order, he was aged twenty-seven and was born on the twenty-fifth day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather was Zhen, his grandfather Xiongfu, his father Xiang, and his mother Lady Ye. His parents and at least one grandparent were living. His elder brother Yijie was a tribute scholar (gongshi); his younger brother was Yican. He married Lady Zheng. He ranked ninetieth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and thirty-third in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xu Xueli, registered in an official household of the Central Guard of the Garrison Command, was a native of Lingbi County in the directly administered metropolitan region and a student of the Directorate of Education. He specialized in the Book of Rites; his courtesy name was Zili. Second in family order, he was aged thirty-one and was born on the tenth day of the fourth month. His great-grandfather Zan, grandfather Xing, and father Jixun were each Guard Commanders and were each granted the title General of Manifest Valor. His mother, Lady Yuan, was granted the title Lady of Chastity. Both parents were living. His elder brother Xueshi was Right Office Chief in the Court of Judicial Review. He married Lady Shen and subsequently married another Lady Shen. He ranked forty-seventh in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 135th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Kuang Pengling, registered in a civilian household of Nanhai County, Guangzhou Prefecture, Guangdong, was an attached student of the county school. He specialized in the Book of Changes; his courtesy name was Youxuan. First in family order, he was aged thirty-six and was born on the sixteenth day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather was Bi, his grandfather Lan, and his father Mengxiao, a government student authorized to wear the official cap and girdle. His mother was Lady Pan, and his stepmother Lady Wu. His father alone was living. His younger brother was Danling. He married Lady Gao. He ranked second in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and 296th in the Metropolitan Examination.

punctuated:
張惟誠，貫錦衣衛籍，順天府永清縣人，國子生。治詩經，字汝思，行五，年二十七，九月十一日生。曾祖清，祖鵬翰〔封明威將軍錦衣衛指揮僉事〕，父麟，母扈氏。具慶下，兄乾、坤、震、巽，弟兌、惟謹，娶易氏。順天府鄉試第九十二名，會試第三百十名。

邢鳳毛，貫陝西西安府咸寧縣儒籍，縣學生。治書經，字世美，行一，年二十八，五月二十五日生。曾祖簡〔通議大夫戶部右侍郎〕，祖謙亨〔奉祠副〕，父寶〔州吏目〕，母吉氏。慈侍下，弟鳳儀、鳳禎、鳳祥，娶桑氏。陝西鄉試第三名，會試第一百三十八名。

鄭人逵，貫福建福州府閩縣民籍，府學附學生。治春秋，字克漸，行四，年三十一，九月十四日生。曾祖仕祿，祖珂，父天秩，前母林氏，母林氏。永感下，兄人達，弟人和〔貢士〕、人穆、人運、人龍、人鳳、人麟，娶林氏，繼娶陳氏。福建鄉試第六十六名，會試第三百八十二名。

張正鵠，貫浙江嘉興府秀水縣民籍，嘉興縣人，府學生。治詩經，字道正，行一，年三十三，七月十六日生。曾祖恩，祖淮〔知縣〕，父桐，母諸氏。慈侍下，娶周氏。浙江鄉試第二十二名，會試第三百八十六名。
translation_en:
Zhang Weicheng was registered with the Embroidered Uniform Guard and was a native of Yongqing County, Shuntian Prefecture. He was a student of the Imperial University. He specialized in the Classic of Poetry; his courtesy name was Rusi. He ranked fifth among his brothers and was twenty-seven years old, born on the eleventh day of the ninth month. His great-grandfather was Qing; his grandfather was Penghan, granted the titles of General of Manifest Might and Assistant Commander of the Embroidered Uniform Guard; his father was Lin, and his mother was née Hu. Both parents were living. His elder brothers were Qian, Kun, Zhen, and Xun; his younger brothers were Dui and Weijin. He married a woman née Yi. He placed ninety-second in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 310th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Xing Fengmao belonged to a scholarly household registered in Xianning County, Xi’an Prefecture, Shaanxi, and was a county school student. He specialized in the Classic of Documents; his courtesy name was Shimei. He ranked first among his brothers and was twenty-eight years old, born on the twenty-fifth day of the fifth month. His great-grandfather was Jian, Grand Master for Thorough Counsel and Right Vice Minister of Revenue; his grandfather was Qianheng, Vice Director of Sacrifices; his father was Bao, a subprefectural Clerk; and his mother was née Ji. His father was deceased and his mother living. His younger brothers were Fengyi, Fengzhen, and Fengxiang. He married a woman née Sang. He placed third in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 138th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zheng Renkui belonged to a civilian household registered in Min County, Fuzhou Prefecture, Fujian, and was an additional student of the prefectural school. He specialized in the Spring and Autumn Annals; his courtesy name was Kejian. He ranked fourth among his brothers and was thirty-one years old, born on the fourteenth day of the ninth month. His great-grandfather was Shilu; his grandfather was Ke; and his father was Tianzhi. His father’s former wife and his mother were both née Lin. Both parents were deceased. His elder brother was Renda; his younger brothers were Renhe, a tribute scholar (gongshi), Renmu, Renyun, Renlong, Renfeng, and Renlin. He married a woman née Lin and subsequently a woman née Chen. He placed sixty-sixth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 382nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Zhenghu belonged to a civilian household registered in Xiushui County, Jiaxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, and was a native of Jiaxing County. He was a prefectural school student. He specialized in the Classic of Poetry; his courtesy name was Daozheng. He ranked first among his brothers and was thirty-three years old, born on the sixteenth day of the seventh month. His great-grandfather was En; his grandfather was Huai, a Magistrate; his father was Tong; and his mother was née Zhu. His father was deceased and his mother living. He married a woman née Zhou. He placed twenty-second in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 386th in the Metropolitan Examination.

title: 隆慶五年進士登科錄
text:

冉夢松〔貫河南開封府中牟縣軍籍，國子生，治書經，字貴卿，行二，年二十八，六月十三日生〕。曾祖藝，祖鼎〔知縣〕，父崇禮〔布政司左參議，進階朝議大夫〕，嫡母王氏〔贈孺人〕，繼母李氏，生母孫氏。嚴侍下。兄夢說〔監生〕。娶蔡氏。河南鄉試第六十三名，會試第三百八十七名。

尹瑾〔貫廣東廣州府東莞縣軍籍，縣學附學生，治易經，字崑潤，行一，年三十一，三月二十日生〕。曾祖重〔審理正〕，祖保衡〔壽官〕，父思問，母黃氏。慈侍下。弟璿、璒。娶彭氏。廣東鄉試第五十二名，會試第七十名。
translation_en:
Yu Deye 虞德燁 was registered in a civilian household in Yiwu County, Jinhua Prefecture, Zhejiang. An Imperial University student specializing in the Book of Rites, he had the courtesy name Guangqing. His family birth order is recorded as 四十一ー [?]. He was aged thirty-two and was born on the twenty-second day of the sixth month. His great-grandfather Shangli was posthumously granted the titles of Grand Master for Thorough Counsel and Right Vice Censor-in-chief of the Censorate; his grandfather Shouyu was Right Vice Minister of Justice at Nanjing; and his father Liangcai was an Imperial University student. His mother was née Jin. His mother alone survived. His elder brothers were Dehuan, a Pacification Commissioner, and Decan; his younger brothers were Dehuang, Deyao (an educational official), Detun (an annotation states “all Imperial University students”), Dexun, Deliao, and Dechan. His wife was née Zhao. He ranked sixty-seventh in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and 299th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tie Zhuan 鐵篆 was registered in a military household of Yongchang Guard, Yunnan, and was originally from Hangzhou Guard, Zhejiang. A student of the Baoshan County school specializing in the Book of Documents, he had the courtesy name Weixin and was third in family birth order. He was aged twenty-six and was born on the fourteenth day of the sixth month. His great-grandfather was Qin, his grandfather Hui, and his father Shixue; his mother was née Nie. Both parents survived. His elder brothers were Fu and Fan, and his younger brother was Jie. His wife was née Mu. He ranked thirty-second in the Yunnan Provincial Examination and 399th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ran Mengsong 冉夢松 was registered in a military household in Zhongmu County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan. An Imperial University student specializing in the Book of Documents, he had the courtesy name Guiqing and was second in family birth order. He was aged twenty-eight and was born on the thirteenth day of the sixth month. His great-grandfather was Yi; his grandfather Ding was a County Magistrate; and his father Chongli was Left Assistant Administration Commissioner in a Provincial Administration Commission, promoted in prestige rank to Grand Master for Court Discussion. His legal mother was née Wang, posthumously granted the title Lady; his stepmother was née Li, and his birth mother née Sun. His father alone survived. His elder brother Mengyue was an Imperial University student. His wife was née Cai. He ranked sixty-third in the Henan Provincial Examination and 387th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yin Jin 尹瑾 was registered in a military household in Dongguan County, Guangzhou Prefecture, Guangdong. An additional student of the county school specializing in the Book of Changes, he had the courtesy name Kunrun and was first in family birth order. He was aged thirty-one and was born on the twentieth day of the third month. His great-grandfather Zhong was a Judicial Officer; his grandfather Baoheng held an honorary official title awarded for longevity; and his father was Siwen. His mother was née Huang. His mother alone survived. His younger brothers were Xuan and Deng. His wife was née Peng. He ranked fifty-second in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and seventieth in the Metropolitan Examination.

何汝成〔貫山西平陽府蒲州，軍籍，州學附學生，治書經，字子誠，行一，年二十八，十二月二十六日生。〕曾祖旺，祖周，父尚仁，母毋氏。具慶下。弟汝中。娶羅氏，繼娶席氏。山西鄉試第四十五名，會試第五十五名。

韓杲〔貫河南汝寧府光州光山縣，民籍，縣學增廣生，治春秋，字汝素，行一，年二十九，十一月十三日生。〕曾祖彦華，祖汴，父文宣，母彭氏，繼母鄢氏。具慶下。弟果、旦、暠、昂、晟。娶余氏。河南鄉試第三十六名，會試第一百九十七名。
translation_en:
Zhou Xian 周憲, courtesy name Yongzhang, was registered in Anfu County, Ji’an Prefecture, Jiangxi, in a civilian household. A supplementary student at the county school specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals, he ranked sixth among his brothers and was aged thirty-five, born on the thirteenth day of the second month. His great-grandfather was Yuxiu, his grandfather Shangcheng, his father Tiguang, and his mother née Liu. Both parents were deceased. His elder brother was Ying; his younger brothers were Que, Yi, Qin, and Cai. His wife was née Peng. He placed eightieth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 297th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Liu Sizhong 劉思中, courtesy name Ziying, was registered in an official household of the Baoding Left Guard under the Daning Regional Military Commission and was a native of Anqiu County, Shandong. A student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Book of Rites, he ranked second among his brothers and was aged thirty-nine, born on the twenty-first day of the ninth month. His great-grandfather Yi, grandfather Jing, and father Lian each held the post of Company Commander. His mother, née Zhang, was invested with the title Lady of Peace (anren). Both parents were living. His elder brother Jianzhong was an Assistant Commander; his younger brothers were Yunzhong, Weizhong, Qizhong, Maozhong, and Lüzhong. His wife, née Ji, was invested with the title Lady of Peace; he subsequently married women née Gu, Wang, and Li. He placed twenty-seventh in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 118th in the Metropolitan Examination.

He Rucheng 何汝成, courtesy name Zicheng, was registered in Puzhou, Pingyang Prefecture, Shanxi, in a military household. A supplementary student at the subprefectural school specializing in the Book of Documents, he ranked first among his brothers and was aged twenty-eight, born on the twenty-sixth day of the twelfth month. His great-grandfather was Wang, his grandfather Zhou, his father Shangren, and his mother née Wu 毋. Both parents were living. His younger brother was Ruzhong. His wife was née Luo; he subsequently married a woman née Xi. He placed forty-fifth in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and fifty-fifth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Han Gao 韓杲, courtesy name Rusu, was registered in Guangshan County, Guangzhou Subprefecture, Runing Prefecture, Henan, in a civilian household. An added student at the county school specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals, he ranked first among his brothers and was aged twenty-nine, born on the thirteenth day of the eleventh month. His great-grandfather was Yanhua, his grandfather Bian, his father Wenxuan, his mother née Peng, and his stepmother née Yan. Both parents were living. His younger brothers were Guo, Dan, Hao 暠, Ang, and Sheng. His wife was née Yu. He placed thirty-sixth in the Henan Provincial Examination and 197th in the Metropolitan Examination.

方肯堂〔貫廣東廣州府南海縣，民籍，番禺縣人，國子生，治詩經，字子升，行一，年四十六，十月十八日生〕。曾祖仁貴，祖直，父紹魁〔知縣〕，母曹氏。永感下，弟肯構、亮工〔同科進士〕、肯穫，娶林氏，繼娶朱氏。廣東鄉試第十五名，會試第一百四十一名。
translation_en:
Zhu Hongmo, registered in Yidu County, Qingzhou Prefecture, Shandong, belonged to a civilian household and was a prefectural school student specializing in the Book of Changes. His courtesy name was Wenfu; he ranked first in birth order, was twenty-nine, and was born on the eighteenth day of the eighth month. His great-grandfather was Feng, his grandfather Haolong, and his father Dezheng; his mother was née Cheng and his stepmother née Zhang. His parents and grandparents were living. He married a woman née Li. He placed third in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 263rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Tian Leyi, registered in Lanyang County, Kaifeng Prefecture, Henan, belonged to an artisan household and was an Imperial University student specializing in the Book of Documents. His courtesy name was Yiqing; he ranked second in birth order, was twenty-eight, and was born on the first day of the eighth month. His great-grandfather was Ao, his grandfather Zongping, and his father Keyou; his mother was née Chang. His father was deceased and his mother living. His elder brother was Leshan and his younger brother Lesheng. He married a woman née Du. He placed sixty-sixth in the Henan Provincial Examination and 322nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Qi Guoru, registered in the Tang County Battalion, Nanyang Prefecture, Henan, belonged to a military officer household and was a county school student specializing in the Book of Documents. His courtesy name was Aidao; he ranked first in birth order, was thirty-one, and was born on the twelfth day of the fourth month. His great-grandfather was Zheng, a Battalion Commander; his grandfather Jing, an Honorary Official; and his father Bi, an Assistant Instructor in the Shuntian prefectural school. His legal mother was née Li, his stepmother née Tian, and his birth mother née Wang. His father was deceased and his mother living. His elder brothers were Guoshu, Guozhuang, Guorui, and Guozhi, the last a Battalion Commander. He married a woman née Fang and subsequently a woman née Xu. He placed third in the Henan Provincial Examination and 279th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Fang Kentang, registered in Nanhai County, Guangzhou Prefecture, Guangdong, belonged to a civilian household and was a native of Panyu County. He was an Imperial University student specializing in the Book of Odes. His courtesy name was Zisheng; he ranked first in birth order, was forty-six, and was born on the eighteenth day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather was Rengui, his grandfather Zhi, and his father Shaokui, a District Magistrate; his mother was née Cao. Both parents were deceased. His younger brothers were Kengou, Lianggong, who became a metropolitan graduate (jinshi) in the same examination year, and Kenhuo. He married a woman née Lin and subsequently a woman née Zhu. He placed fifteenth in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and 141st in the Metropolitan Examination.

程遜〔貫直隸大名府長垣縣民籍，國子生，治詩經，字惟謙，行一，年三十三，七月十五日生〕。曾祖磊，祖岱，父宦，母朱氏，繼母王氏。嚴侍下，兄遷，弟文選、通、述、蓮、遼、逢、邁、邁，娶趙氏。順天府鄉試第一百十三名，會試第二百五十九名。

傅作舟〔貫湖廣荆州府江陵縣民籍，國子生，治書經，字元濟，行二，年三十八，八月二十七日生〕。曾祖伯海，祖鎭，父朝珍〔推官〕，母萬氏。永感下，娶萬氏。湖廣鄉試第六十六名，會試第一百七十七名。

趙鷺〔貫福建泉州府晉江縣軍籍，國子生，治春秋，字朝雝，行三，年三十七，正月二十一日生〕。曾祖真應，祖惟德，父世讓，嫡母孫氏，生母王氏。慈侍下，兄鳳、鶴、鶚，弟鸃，娶陳氏，繼娶陳氏。福建鄉試第十四名，會試第一百八十七名。

梅淳〔貫直隸太平府當塗縣軍籍，國子生，治詩經，字德涵，行一，年二十九，十月十二日生〕。曾祖玘〔義官〕，祖鳳，父勝，母潘氏，繼母谷氏。具慶下，弟澤、溥，娶楊氏。應天府鄉試第八十六名，會試第一百五十三名。
translation_en:
Cheng Xun 程遜, registered in a civilian household in Changyuan County, Daming Prefecture, in the directly administered metropolitan region, was a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Book of Odes. His courtesy name was Weiqian; he ranked first in his family and was aged thirty-three, born on the fifteenth day of the seventh month. His great-grandfather was Lei, his grandfather Dai, and his father Huan; his mother was née Zhu and his stepmother née Wang. His father alone was surviving. His elder brother was Qian; his younger brothers are listed as Wenxuan, Tong, Shu, Lian, Liao, Feng, Mai, and Mai [name divisions and repeated Mai doubtful: ?]. His wife was née Zhao. He placed 113th in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 259th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Fu Zuozhou 傅作舟, registered in a civilian household in Jiangling County, Jingzhou Prefecture, Huguang, was a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Book of Documents. His courtesy name was Yuanji; he ranked second in his family and was aged thirty-eight, born on the twenty-seventh day of the eighth month. His great-grandfather was Bohai, his grandfather Zhen, and his father Chaozhen, a Judge; his mother was née Wan. Both parents were deceased. His wife was née Wan. He placed sixty-sixth in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 177th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhao Lu 趙鷺, registered in a military household in Jinjiang County, Quanzhou Prefecture, Fujian, was a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals. His courtesy name was Chaoyong; he ranked third in his family and was aged thirty-seven, born on the twenty-first day of the first month. His great-grandfather was Zhenying, his grandfather Weide, and his father Shirang; his legal mother was née Sun and his birth mother née Wang. His mother alone was surviving. His elder brothers were Feng, He, and E, and his younger brother was Yi. His wife was née Chen; he subsequently married another woman née Chen. He placed fourteenth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 187th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Mei Chun 梅淳, registered in a military household in Dangtu County, Taiping Prefecture, in the directly administered metropolitan region, was a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Book of Odes. His courtesy name was Dehan; he ranked first in his family and was aged twenty-nine, born on the twelfth day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather was Qi, an honorary official; his grandfather was Feng and his father Sheng. His mother was née Pan and his stepmother née Gu. Both parents were surviving. His younger brothers were Ze and Pu. His wife was née Yang. He placed eighty-sixth in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 153rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

吳從龍〔貫江西南昌府寧州，民籍，州學生，治易經，字希德，行三，年二十七，八月初六日生〕。曾祖仲默，祖勝〔布政司都事〕，父全，母時氏，繼母周氏。重慶下，弟從龐、從靇、從寵、從龔，娶劉氏。江西鄉試第三十名，會試第三百九名。

周文卿〔貫湖廣武昌府江夏縣，民籍，國子生，治詩經，字藎之，行一，年三十六，十二月十五日生〕。曾祖友淮，祖伯鸞，父濟〔典史〕，母陳氏。具慶下，弟文獻、文學、文郁、文邦、文冠，娶張氏。湖廣鄉試第八名，會試第三百六十四名。

高應聘〔貫山西平陽府絳州稷山縣，軍籍，縣學增廣生，治詩經，字志尹，行一，年三十四，十二月二十九日生〕。曾祖琚，祖續，父爵，母白氏，繼母薛氏。具慶下，弟應命，娶薛氏，繼娶馬氏。山西鄉試第二十四名，會試第一百七十三名。
translation_en:
Wu Conglong 吳從龍, courtesy name Xide, was registered in Ningzhou, Nanchang Prefecture, Jiangxi, in a civilian household. A student of the subprefectural school specializing in the Book of Changes, he was third in birth order, aged twenty-seven, and born on the sixth day of the eighth month. His great-grandfather was Zhongmo; his grandfather, Sheng, was Chief Clerk in a Provincial Administration Commission; his father was Quan; his mother was née Shi, and his stepmother née Zhou. His parents and grandparents were living. His younger brothers were Congpang 從龐, Conglong 從靇, Congchong 從寵, and Conggong 從龔. He married a woman née Liu. He placed thirtieth in the Jiangxi Provincial Examination and 309th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Huang Ce 黃策, courtesy name Jiayou, was registered in Xianning County, Xi’an Prefecture, Shaanxi, in an artisan household, and was a native of Puzhou, Shanxi. A student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Book of Documents, he was first in birth order, aged thirty-two, and born on the nineteenth day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather was Peng; his grandfather, Mengyan, held an honorary title for longevity; his father, Shikui, held a seventh-rank prestige title. His mother was née Zhu, and his stepmother née Meng. His mother was living, and his father deceased. His younger brothers were Zhuan, Jian 簡, Ji, and Jian 箋. He married a woman née Lu. He placed forty-third in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 302nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhou Wenqing 周文卿, courtesy name Jinzhi, was registered in Jiangxia County, Wuchang Prefecture, Huguang, in a civilian household. A student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Book of Odes, he was first in birth order, aged thirty-six, and born on the fifteenth day of the twelfth month. His great-grandfather was Youhuai; his grandfather was Boluan; his father, Ji, was a Clerk; and his mother was née Chen. Both parents were living. His younger brothers were Wenxian, Wenxue, Wenyu, Wenbang, and Wenguan. He married a woman née Zhang. He placed eighth in the Huguang Provincial Examination and 364th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Gao Yingpin 高應聘, courtesy name Zhiyin, was registered in Jishan County, Jiangzhou, Pingyang Prefecture, Shanxi, in a military household. An added student of the county school specializing in the Book of Odes, he was first in birth order, aged thirty-four, and born on the twenty-ninth day of the twelfth month. His great-grandfather was Ju; his grandfather was Xu; his father was Jue; his mother was née Bai, and his stepmother née Xue. Both parents were living. His younger brother was Yingming. He married a woman née Xue and subsequently a woman née Ma. He placed twenty-fourth in the Shanxi Provincial Examination and 173rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

曾祖杲　祖尭輔〔封中書舍人〕　父汝松〔工科都給事中〕　母曲氏〔封孺人〕　繼母徐氏
永感下　兄允升允衆允恭允誅允謙　弟允𦂶允執　娶王氏
順天府鄉試第三十九名　會試第二百六十四名
孟一脉〔貫山東兗州府東平州東阿縣軍籍　縣學增廣生治詩經字嗣孔行一年二十九正月二十五日生〕
曾祖祥　祖繼文　父存義　母張氏
嚴侍下　弟一傳　一支　一心〔貢士〕　一魁　娶張氏
山東鄉試第十四名　會試第二百三十六名
punctuated:
李應辰〔貫浙江寧波府慈谿縣，民籍，縣學附學生，治《詩經》，字惟星，行二百七，年二十九，十一月二十四日生〕。曾祖鑣〔巡檢〕，祖沔，父檟，母陳氏，繼母韓氏。具慶下，兄鳴春、應範、應節，弟應龍、應策、應試，娶陳氏。浙江鄉試第三十二名，會試第二十九名。

韓紹〔貫浙江湖州府歸安縣，軍籍，烏程縣人，府學生，治《易經》，字光祖，行一，年三十二，六月二十四日生〕。曾祖茂，祖繼，父志孝，母李氏。慈侍下，弟嬉、炣，娶沈氏。浙江鄉試第五十九名，會試第一百二十二名。

馬允登〔貫直隸河間府景州東光縣，民籍，山西陵川縣人，縣學生，治《書經》，字叔先，行六，年二十四，十一月十一日生〕。曾祖杲，祖堯輔〔封中書舍人〕，父汝松〔工科都給事中〕，母曲氏〔封孺人〕，繼母徐氏。永感下，兄允升、允衆、允恭、允述、允謙，弟允端、允執，娶王氏。順天府鄉試第三十九名，會試第二百六十四名。

孟一脉〔貫山東兖州府東平州東阿縣，軍籍，縣學增廣生，治《詩經》，字嗣孔，行一，年二十九，正月二十五日生〕。曾祖祥，祖繼文，父存義，母張氏。嚴侍下，弟一傳、一支、一心〔貢士〕、一魁，娶張氏。山東鄉試第十四名，會試第二百三十六名。
translation_en:
Li Yingchen, registered in Cixi County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang, belonged to a civilian household and was an attached student of the county school; he specialized in the Book of Odes, had the courtesy name Weixing, ranked two hundred and seventh [?] in family birth order, and was aged twenty-nine, born on the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month. His great-grandfather was Biao (Police Chief), his grandfather Mian, and his father Jia; his mother was née Chen and his stepmother née Han. Both parents were living. His elder brothers were Mingchun, Yingfan, and Yingjie, and his younger brothers Yinglong, Yingce, and Yingshi; he married a woman née Chen. He placed thirty-second in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and twenty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Han Shao, registered in Gui’an County, Huzhou Prefecture, Zhejiang, belonged to a military household and was originally from Wucheng County; he was a prefectural school student specializing in the Book of Changes, had the courtesy name Guangzu, ranked first in family birth order, and was aged thirty-two, born on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month. His great-grandfather was Mao, his grandfather Ji, and his father Zhixiao; his mother was née Li. His mother alone was living. His younger brothers were Xi and Ke; he married a woman née Shen. He placed fifty-ninth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and one hundred and twenty-second in the Metropolitan Examination.

Ma Yundeng, registered in Dongguang County, Jing Subprefecture, Hejian Prefecture, in the directly administered metropolitan region, belonged to a civilian household and was originally from Lingchuan County, Shanxi; he was a county school student specializing in the Book of Documents, had the courtesy name Shuxian, ranked sixth in family birth order, and was aged twenty-four, born on the eleventh day of the eleventh month. His great-grandfather was Gao, his grandfather Yaofu (honorarily appointed Secretariat Drafter), and his father Rusong (Chief Supervising Secretary of the Office of Scrutiny for Works); his mother was née Qu (honorarily titled Lady of Respect), and his stepmother née Xu. His parents and grandparents were deceased. His elder brothers were Yunsheng, Yunzhong, Yungong, Yunshu, and Yunqian, and his younger brothers Yunduan and Yunzhi; he married a woman née Wang. He placed thirty-ninth in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and two hundred and sixty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Meng Yimai, registered in Dong’e County, Dongping Subprefecture, Yanzhou Prefecture, Shandong, belonged to a military household and was an additional student of the county school; he specialized in the Book of Odes, had the courtesy name Sikong, ranked first in family birth order, and was aged twenty-nine, born on the twenty-fifth day of the first month. His great-grandfather was Xiang, his grandfather Jiwen, and his father Cunyi; his mother was née Zhang. His father alone was living. His younger brothers were Yichuan, Yizhi, Yixin (tribute student), and Yikui; he married a woman née Zhang. He placed fourteenth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and two hundred and thirty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.

title: 隆慶五年進士登科錄
text:
周應中〔貫順天府府軍衛籍浙江會稽縣人府學附學生治易經字正甫行二年二十七六月初五日生〕
曾祖玘　祖拱　父珊　母王氏
具慶下　兄允中　弟時中　用中
順天府鄉試第二十六名　會試第三百四十八名
楊維新〔貫直隸鎮江府丹徒縣民籍　縣學生治易經字克一行二年三十九月十二日生〕
曾祖瑠　祖秀　父春　母厲氏
慈侍下　兄維立　弟維城維藩維翰　娶王氏　繼娶吳氏
應天府鄉試第三十八名　會試第一百三十名
===
張會宗〔貫廣東潮州府澄海縣民籍福建晉江縣人澄海縣學生治易經字于震行一年三十十月二十一日生〕
曾祖質巖　祖基　父文　嫡母柳氏　生母陳氏
永感下　弟九思　娶郭氏
廣東鄉試第二名　會試第一百六十二名
趙世勛〔貫陝西綏德衛官籍　國子生治春秋字光遠行一年三十六十一月二十五日生〕
曾祖源　祖賓　父真〔百戶〕　嫡母李氏　生母郭氏
慈侍下　娶張氏　繼娶霍氏　李氏
陝西鄉試第十八名　會試第三百五十三名

貫廣東潮州府澄海縣民籍福建晉江縣人 澄海縣學生

punctuated:
周應中〔貫順天府府軍衛籍，浙江會稽縣人，府學附學生，治易經，字正甫，行二，年二十七，六月初五日生〕。曾祖玘，祖拱，父珊，母王氏。具慶下，兄允中，弟時中、用中。順天府鄉試第二十六名，會試第三百四十八名。

楊維新〔貫直隸鎮江府丹徒縣民籍，縣學生，治易經，字克一，行二，年三十，九月十二日生〕。曾祖瑠，祖秀，父春，母厲氏。慈侍下，兄維立，弟維城、維藩、維翰，娶王氏，繼娶吳氏。應天府鄉試第三十八名，會試第一百三十名。

張會宗〔貫廣東潮州府澄海縣民籍，福建晉江縣人，澄海縣學生，治易經，字于震，行一，年三十，十月二十一日生〕。曾祖質巖，祖基，父文，嫡母柳氏，生母陳氏。永感下，弟九思，娶郭氏。廣東鄉試第二名，會試第一百六十二名。

趙世勛〔貫陝西綏德衛官籍，國子生，治春秋，字光遠，行一，年三十六，十一月二十五日生〕。曾祖源，祖賓，父真〔百戶〕，嫡母李氏，生母郭氏。慈侍下，娶張氏，繼娶霍氏、李氏。陝西鄉試第十八名，會試第三百五十三名。
translation_en:
Zhou Yingzhong, registered with the Fujun Guard in Shuntian Prefecture and a native of Kuaiji County, Zhejiang, was a supplementary student at the prefectural school specializing in the Book of Changes. His courtesy name was Zhengfu; he was second in birth order, aged twenty-seven, and born on the fifth day of the sixth lunar month. His great-grandfather was Qi, his grandfather Gong, his father Shan, and his mother née Wang. Both parents were living. His elder brother was Yunzhong, and his younger brothers were Shizhong and Yongzhong. He ranked twenty-sixth in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 348th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Yang Weixin, registered in a civilian household in Dantu County, Zhenjiang Prefecture, in the directly administered metropolitan region, was a county-school student specializing in the Book of Changes. His courtesy name was Keyi; he was second in birth order, aged thirty, and born on the twelfth day of the ninth lunar month. His great-grandfather was Liu, his grandfather Xiu, his father Chun, and his mother née Li. His father was deceased and his mother living. His elder brother was Weili, and his younger brothers were Weicheng, Weifan, and Weihan. He married a woman née Wang and subsequently a woman née Wu. He ranked thirty-eighth in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 130th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhang Huizong, registered in a civilian household in Chenghai County, Chaozhou Prefecture, Guangdong, and a native of Jinjiang County, Fujian, was a Chenghai county-school student specializing in the Book of Changes. His courtesy name was Yuzhen; he was first in birth order, aged thirty, and born on the twenty-first day of the tenth lunar month. His great-grandfather was Zhiyan, his grandfather Ji, and his father Wen; his legal mother was née Liu and his birth mother née Chen. His parents were deceased. His younger brother was Jiusi. He married a woman née Guo. He ranked second in the Guangdong Provincial Examination and 162nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Zhao Shixun, registered in an officer household of the Suide Guard, Shaanxi, was a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Spring and Autumn Annals. His courtesy name was Guangyuan; he was first in birth order, aged thirty-six, and born on the twenty-fifth day of the eleventh lunar month. His great-grandfather was Yuan, his grandfather Bin, and his father Zhen, a company commander; his legal mother was née Li and his birth mother née Guo. His father was deceased and his mother living. He married a woman née Zhang and subsequently women née Huo and née Li. He ranked eighteenth in the Shaanxi Provincial Examination and 353rd in the Metropolitan Examination.

title: 隆慶五年進士登科錄
text:
高文炳〔貫直隸松江府上海縣軍籍國子生治書經字象南行三年三十八十月十一日生〕
曾祖鉉〔贈奉政大夫修正庶尹府同知〕祖祚父欽嫡母韓氏生母宋氏
永感下兄鄂弟文節娶劉氏繼娶曹氏
順天府鄉試第三名會試第二百八十二名
李藎〔貫四川成都右衛軍籍直隸永平衞人成都縣學生治詩經字臣忱行二年二十八二月初五日生〕
曾祖楫祖裕父鳳鳴〔教諭〕嫡母杜氏繼母何氏生母賀氏
永感下兄天培蓁蕡弟芫英娶葛氏
四川鄉試第五十四名會試第六十一名
===
魏良臣〔貫福建建寧府甌寧縣民籍縣學附學生治詩經字以忠行一年二十七四月初二日生〕
曾祖多歷祖鶍父文亨母鄭氏
重慶下弟良策良弼良輔良翰良士良貴娶鄭氏
福建鄉試第十名會試第二百九十八名
陸夢熊〔貫浙江紹興府餘姚縣民籍國子生治易經字伯祥行八年三十十二月二十七日生〕
曾祖懷祖表〔縣丞贈刑部主事〕父一龍前母王氏母蔣氏繼母翁氏
慈侍下弟夢桂夢圭〔聽選官〕夢鰲夢卜〔監生〕夢松夢日夢賢夢驄娶施氏
浙江鄉試第八名會試第六十四名

治詩經字臣忱行二年二十八二月初五日生

永感下兄天培蓁蕡弟芃英娶葛氏

===
魏良臣貫福建建寧府甌寧縣民籍縣學附學生
治詩經字以忠行一年二十七四月初二日生
曾祖多歷祖蘇父文亨母鄭氏
重慶下弟良策良弼良嶹良翰良士良吉良貝娶鄭氏
福建鄉試第十名會試第二百九十八名
陸夢熊貫浙江紹興府餘姚縣民籍國子生
治易經字伯祥行八年三十七二月二十七日生
曾祖懷祖鐩〔贈刑部主事縣丞〕父一龍前母王氏母蔣氏繼母翁氏
慈侍下弟夢桂夢圭〔聽選官〕夢鰲夢卜〔監生〕夢松夢日夢賢夢驄娶施氏
浙江鄉試第八名會試第六十四名
punctuated:
高文炳〔貫直隸松江府上海縣軍籍，國子生，治書經，字象南，行三，年三十八，十月十一日生〕。曾祖鉉〔贈奉政大夫修正庶尹府同知〕，祖祚，父欽，嫡母韓氏，生母宋氏。永感下。兄鄂，弟文節。娶劉氏，繼娶曹氏。順天府鄉試第三名，會試第二百八十二名。

李藎〔貫四川成都右衛軍籍，直隸永平衞人，成都縣學生，治詩經，字臣忱，行二，年二十八，二月初五日生〕。曾祖楫，祖裕，父鳳鳴〔教諭〕，嫡母杜氏，繼母何氏，生母賀氏。永感下。兄天培、蓁、蕡，弟芫、英。娶葛氏。四川鄉試第五十四名，會試第六十一名。

魏良臣〔貫福建建寧府甌寧縣民籍，縣學附學生，治詩經，字以忠，行一，年二十七，四月初二日生〕。曾祖多歷，祖鶍，父文亨，母鄭氏。重慶下。弟良策、良弼、良輔、良翰、良士、良貴。娶鄭氏。福建鄉試第十名，會試第二百九十八名。

陸夢熊〔貫浙江紹興府餘姚縣民籍，國子生，治易經，字伯祥，行八，年三十，十二月二十七日生〕。曾祖懷，祖表〔縣丞，贈刑部主事〕，父一龍，前母王氏，母蔣氏，繼母翁氏。慈侍下。弟夢桂、夢圭〔聽選官〕、夢鰲、夢卜〔監生〕、夢松、夢日、夢賢、夢驄。娶施氏。浙江鄉試第八名，會試第六十四名。
translation_en:
Gao Wenbing, registered in a military household in Shanghai County, Songjiang Prefecture, in the directly administered metropolitan region, was a student of the Directorate of Education. He specialized in the Book of Documents; his courtesy name was Xiangnan. He ranked third among his brothers and was thirty-eight years old, born on the eleventh day of the tenth month. His great-grandfather was Xuan, posthumously granted the title Grand Master for Governance and the office of prefectural vice prefect (the intervening wording 修正庶尹 is uncertain [?]); his grandfather was Zuo, and his father was Qin. His father's principal wife was née Han, and his birth mother was née Song. Both parents were deceased. His elder brother was E, and his younger brother was Wenjie. He married a woman née Liu and subsequently a woman née Cao. He placed third in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 282nd in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Jin was registered in a military household of the Chengdu Right Guard in Sichuan and was originally from Yongping Guard in the directly administered metropolitan region. He was a student of the Chengdu County School and specialized in the Book of Odes. His courtesy name was Chenchen. He ranked second among his brothers and was twenty-eight years old, born on the fifth day of the second month. His great-grandfather was Ji, his grandfather was Yu, and his father was Fengming, a county school instructor. His father's principal wife was née Du, his stepmother was née He (何), and his birth mother was née He (賀). Both parents were deceased. His elder brothers were Tianpei, Zhen, and Fen; his younger brothers were Yuan and Ying. He married a woman née Ge. He placed fifty-fourth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and sixty-first in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wei Liangchen, registered in a civilian household in Ouning County, Jianning Prefecture, Fujian, was an supplementary student of the county school. He specialized in the Book of Odes; his courtesy name was Yizhong. He ranked first among his brothers and was twenty-seven years old, born on the second day of the fourth month. His great-grandfather was Duoli, his grandfather was Yi (鶍), his father was Wenheng, and his mother was née Zheng. His parents and grandparents were living. His younger brothers were Liangce, Liangbi, Liangfu, Lianghan, Liangshi, and Lianggui. He married a woman née Zheng. He placed tenth in the Fujian Provincial Examination and 298th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Lu Mengxiong, registered in a civilian household in Yuyao County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, was a student of the Directorate of Education. He specialized in the Book of Changes; his courtesy name was Boxiang. He ranked eighth among his brothers and was thirty years old, born on the twenty-seventh day of the twelfth month. His great-grandfather was Huai; his grandfather was Biao, a county vice magistrate posthumously appointed secretary in the Ministry of Justice; and his father was Yilong. His father's former wife was née Wang, his mother was née Jiang, and his stepmother was née Weng. His father was deceased, and his mother was living. His younger brothers were Menggui (夢桂), Menggui (夢圭), an official awaiting selection for appointment, Meng'ao, Mengbu, a student of the Directorate of Education, Mengsong, Mengri, Mengxian, and Mengcong. He married a woman née Shi. He placed eighth in the Zhejiang Provincial Examination and sixty-fourth in the Metropolitan Examination.

title: 隆慶五年進士登科錄
text:
宋仕〔貫山東濟南府德州平原縣軍籍國子生治易經字汝學行一年三十九月二十三日生〕
曾祖錫〔工部營繕所所丞〕祖台〔府知事〕父以方〔壽官〕母楊氏繼母賈氏
重慶下弟僑倬娶王氏

姜璧〔貫順天府霸州文安縣民籍縣學生治禮記字完卿行一年三十十二月初一日生〕
曾祖洪祖隆父師呂前母董氏母劉氏
具慶下弟璽瑩玳瑤娶王氏

宋仕〔貫山東濟南府德州平原縣軍籍，國子生，治易經，字汝學，行一，年三十，九月二十三日生〕。曾祖錫〔工部營繕所所丞〕，祖台〔府知事〕，父以方〔壽官〕，母楊氏，繼母賈氏。重慶下，弟僑、倬，娶王氏。山東鄉試第二十一名，會試第二百九十四名。

姜璧〔貫順天府霸州文安縣民籍，縣學生，治禮記，字完卿，行一，年三十，十二月初一日生〕。曾祖洪，祖隆，父師呂，前母董氏，母劉氏。具慶下，弟璽、瑩、玳、瑤，娶王氏。順天府鄉試第二十七名，會試第三百四十七名。

吳之彥〔貫直隸蘇州府太倉州民籍，州學增廣生，治易經，字世美，行一，年三十，十一月初十日生〕。曾祖珮，祖朝林〔監生〕，父文炳，母王氏，繼母金氏。具慶下，兄之鼎〔監生〕，弟之鵬〔監生〕、之傳、之任、之綱、之紀、之良，娶王氏。應天府鄉試第一百二十八名，會試第三百五十八名。

董選〔貫河南河南府嵩縣民籍，縣學生，治易經，字叔仁，行三，年四十四，四月二十五日生〕。曾祖士新，祖昂，父相〔按察司副使〕，母王氏。永感下，兄遂〔按察司副使〕、遜〔歲貢生〕，弟适〔歲貢生〕，娶陸氏。河南鄉試第二名，會試第二百六十名。
translation_en:
Song Shi, registered in a military household in Pingyuan County, Dezhou Subprefecture, Jinan Prefecture, Shandong, was a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Book of Changes. His courtesy name was Ruxue; he ranked first in his family and was thirty years old, born on the twenty-third day of the ninth month. His great-grandfather was Xi, Deputy of the Construction Office under the Ministry of Works; his grandfather was Tai, a prefectural Clerk; and his father was Yifang, an honorary official for longevity. His mother was née Yang, and his stepmother née Jia. His parents and grandparents were living. His younger brothers were Qiao and Zhuo, and his wife was née Wang. He placed twenty-first in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 294th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Jiang Bi, registered in a civilian household in Wen'an County, Bazhou Subprefecture, Shuntian Prefecture, was a county school student specializing in the Book of Rites. His courtesy name was Wanqing; he ranked first in his family and was thirty years old, born on the first day of the twelfth month. His great-grandfather was Hong, his grandfather Long, and his father Shilü. His father's former wife was née Dong, and his mother née Liu. Both parents were living. His younger brothers were Xi, Ying, Dai, and Yao, and his wife was née Wang. He placed twenty-seventh in the Shuntian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 347th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Wu Zhiyan, registered in a civilian household in Taicang Subprefecture, Suzhou Prefecture, in the directly administered metropolitan region, was an additional student of the subprefectural school specializing in the Book of Changes. His courtesy name was Shimei; he ranked first in his family and was thirty years old, born on the tenth day of the eleventh month. His great-grandfather was Pei; his grandfather was Chaolin, a student of the Directorate of Education; and his father was Wenbing. His mother was née Wang, and his stepmother née Jin. Both parents were living. His elder brother was Zhiding, a student of the Directorate of Education; his younger brothers were Zhipeng, also a student of the Directorate of Education, Zhichuan, Zhiren, Zhigang, Zhiji, and Zhiliang. His wife was née Wang. He placed 128th in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and 358th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Dong Xuan, registered in a civilian household in Song County, Henan Prefecture, Henan, was a county school student specializing in the Book of Changes. His courtesy name was Shuren; he ranked third in his family and was forty-four years old, born on the twenty-fifth day of the fourth month. His great-grandfather was Shixin, his grandfather Ang, and his father Xiang, a Surveillance Vice Commissioner. His mother was née Wang. Both parents were deceased. His elder brothers were Sui, a Surveillance Vice Commissioner, and Xun, an annual tribute student; his younger brother was Shi, also an annual tribute student. His wife was née Lu. He placed second in the Henan Provincial Examination and 260th in the Metropolitan Examination.

趙世卿〔貫山東濟南府歷城縣軍籍，縣學增廣生，治詩經，字象賢，行一，年三十四，九月二十四日生〕。曾祖欒〔壽官〕，祖強，父應奎〔巡檢〕，母姚氏。慈侍下，弟世恩、世第、世功、世光，娶孟氏。山東鄉試第五十四名，會試第三百九十六名。

李棟〔貫河南彰德府磁州涉縣民籍，國子生，治書經，字尚隆，行二，年三十五，十一月初三日生〕。曾祖大良，祖仁，父紹〔知縣〕，母王氏。慈侍下，兄權、柵、梯、模，弟枌、杭，娶薛氏。河南鄉試第二十五名，會試第一百九十九名。

郭如暄〔貫四川叙州府富順縣民籍，縣學附學生，治詩經，字元春，行四，年三十七，六月初五日生〕。曾祖體宗〔衛經歷，贈監察御史〕，祖瑢〔義官〕，父宴〔貢士〕，前母胡氏，母喻氏。慈侍下，兄惟誠〔省祭官〕、惟鼎、如葵、如任、大器、如𨯔〔貢士〕、世藩、如谿、如約，弟璞、如範、如璋、如矩，娶甘氏。四川鄉試第三十六名，會試第三十九名。

孫秉陽〔貫直隸鳳陽府懷遠縣民籍，國子生，治詩經，字夢旭，行二，年三十七，四月初八日生〕。曾祖聚，祖蘭，父立，母蕭氏，繼母龔氏。慈侍下，兄竒，弟章〔監生〕、應庖、秉彜、廉、慶、袞、鎮、恜、棟、松、橘、朴，娶周氏。應天府鄉試第一百四十六名，會試第二十六名。
translation_en:
Zhao Shiqing, of military household registration in Licheng County, Jinan Prefecture, Shandong, was an additional student of the county Confucian school specializing in the Book of Odes. His courtesy name was Xiangxian; he ranked first in birth order and was thirty-four, born on the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month. His great-grandfather was Luan, an honorary official for longevity; his grandfather was Qiang; his father was Yingkui, a Police Chief; and his mother was née Yao. His father was deceased and his mother living. His younger brothers were Shien, Shidi, Shigong, and Shiguang, and his wife was née Meng. He placed fifty-fourth in the Shandong Provincial Examination and 396th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Li Dong, of civilian household registration in She County, Cizhou Subprefecture, Zhangde Prefecture, Henan, was a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Book of Documents. His courtesy name was Shanglong; he ranked second in birth order and was thirty-five, born on the third day of the eleventh month. His great-grandfather was Daliang; his grandfather was Ren; his father was Shao, a District Magistrate; and his mother was née Wang. His father was deceased and his mother living. His elder brothers were Quan, Zha, Ti, and Mo; his younger brothers were Fen and Hang; and his wife was née Xue. He placed twenty-fifth in the Henan Provincial Examination and 199th in the Metropolitan Examination.

Guo Ruxuan, of civilian household registration in Fushun County, Xuzhou Prefecture, Sichuan, was an attached student of the county Confucian school specializing in the Book of Odes. His courtesy name was Yuanchun; he ranked fourth in birth order and was thirty-seven, born on the fifth day of the sixth month. His great-grandfather was Tizong, a Command Registrar posthumously granted the title of Investigating Censor; his grandfather was Rong, an honorary official for charitable contributions; and his father was Yan, a tribute scholar. His father's former wife was née Hu, and his mother was née Yu. His father was deceased and his mother living. His elder brothers were Weicheng, a provincial sacrificial official [?]; Weiding; Rukui; Ruren; Daqi; Ru𨯔 [second character's reading uncertain], a tribute scholar; Shifan; Ruxi; and Ruyue. His younger brothers were Pu, Rufan, Ruzhang, and Ruju, and his wife was née Gan. He placed thirty-sixth in the Sichuan Provincial Examination and thirty-ninth in the Metropolitan Examination.

Sun Bingyang, of civilian household registration in Huaiyuan County, Fengyang Prefecture, in the directly administered metropolitan region, was a student of the Directorate of Education specializing in the Book of Odes. His courtesy name was Mengxu; he ranked second in birth order and was thirty-seven, born on the eighth day of the fourth month. His great-grandfather was Ju; his grandfather was Lan; his father was Li; his mother was née Xiao; and his stepmother was née Gong. His father was deceased and his mother living. His elder brother was Qi. His younger brothers were Zhang, a student of the Directorate of Education; Yingpao [?]; Bingyi; Lian; Qing; Gun; Zhen; Chi; Dong; Song; Ju; and Pu. His wife was née Zhou. He placed 146th in the Yingtian Prefecture Provincial Examination and twenty-sixth in the Metropolitan Examination.
